Steps.1: Check on schematic that there are TVS diodes to protect the device from spikes from the power inputs.
Steps.2: Check on the datasheet of the TVS diodes the clamping voltage.
Steps.3: Check on the datasheet of the DC/DC converter the maximum voltage that it withstands.
Steps.4: Check that the clamping voltage is less than the maximum voltage of the DC/DC converter.
Steps.5: Connect the hw_DAA to a DAA CS harness.
Steps.6: Connect the output of the PCB for Normal Surge Voltage to the DAA CS harness power input using a DC power connector (according to the attached diagram) to supply the hw_DAA.
Steps.7: Connect the waveform generator to the PCB for Normal Surge Voltage through a BNC cable MALE - MALE.
Steps.8: Connect the power supply sources with some bananas to the PCB for Normal Surge Voltage (according to the attached diagram).
Steps.9: Switch on the power supply sources.
Steps.10: Connect in series three channels CH1 of MED0023 (30V) & CH2 of MED0023 (30V) & MED0189 (24V) to achieve 84V.
Steps.11: Set 30V, 24V or 12V respectively, and 3A on the power supply sources.
Steps.12: Press the On/Off button to turn on the channels of the power supply sources.
Steps.14: Connect a pendrive with the .csv configuration file to the waveform generator.
Steps.15: Select the attached waveform from the pendrive memory.
Steps.17: Connect an oscilloscope probe (CH1) to the output of the PCB for Normal Surge Voltage with x10 attenuation.
Steps.18: Connect an oscilloscope probe (CH2) to the soldered wire at C20 pads with x10 attenuation.
Steps.19: Configure CH1 (Voltage Spikes): set the vertical offset to ~-45V and the vertical grid to 12 V/div.
Steps.20: Configure CH2 (Output of the DC/DC Converter): set the vertical offset to ~-3V and the vertical grid to 2 V/div.
Steps.21: Set the horizontal grid to 1 ms/div and center the horizontal trigger position at the center of the oscilloscope screen.
Steps.22: Set the trigger level to ~50V, rising edge and source the CH1.
Steps.23: Ensure that the attenuation is set to x10 and BW limit OFF (on both channels).
Steps.25: Press the Output button of thw waveform generator.
Steps.26: Check that the DC/DC converter continues to regulate its output voltage as normal, unaffected by the transient.
